title: invcibees (water)
description: makes bees invicible to water and regenerates them while in their hive
body:
basically this datapacks makes all bees have water breathing forever, and when touching water, bees are given resistence 10 and regen 10 so you dont gotta worry about them if theyre stuck in a water bubble for an extended period of time, and while in their hive, they will have regen 2

this datapack is only for 1.21.5, but i think you can easily change by changing the pack format, but idk if it will still work

if you want the bees to only be invincible to water and not to the regen in their hive you can just edit the tick.mcfunction file with the notes app and remove the last line of code check gallery to see what i mean

if you've got any questions or what, just dm me on discord, my user is someoxe

ill prolly update it to 1.21.6 when i update my world to it aswell
